Fetch script: pauses between requests, URL-encodes file names, converts Google Drive /file/d/<ID>/view links, and touches no login-protected site.
Extract: detects pages with no text layer and OCRs them (or documents the loss honestly). Repeating headers and footers are stripped, but headings and section boundaries are kept.
Clean: removes artefacts without destroying structure. PIPELINE.md lists the rules and one thing deliberately not stripped.
Chunk: structure-aware (sections, then paragraphs, then sentences) with overlap and a target size. Not a naive fixed-size splitter.
Embed: one vector per chunk, model read from EMBED_MODEL, never hard-coded.
Store: writes id, text, vector, metadata to ChromaDB. Chunk ids are stable and deterministic, so re-indexing does not duplicate chunks.
Metadata is complete on every chunk: source, section, page, doc_version, superseded (boolean). Query Chroma and confirm no chunk is missing a field and no superseded is null.
The superseded document's chunks carry superseded: true; current ones carry false.
Collection metadata contains the embedding model name and vector dimension (see section 8).
Re-running the indexer is idempotent: chunk count is unchanged after a second run (collection rebuilt or upserted, not appended twice).
On success the indexer expires the semantic cache (see section 6).
A bad document (corrupt PDF) does not crash the whole job silently: it logs the failure and either skips with a clear message or fails with a non-zero exit.

docs/PIPELINE.md contains: which documents needed OCR, one before-and-after example of a mangled table, what could not be recovered, chunk size and overlap, storage amplification (stored tokens divided by original tokens), model name, vector dimension, where the pin lives, chunk count, and the metadata schema.

Chunk tuning table: at least three (size, overlap) configurations, each with measured recall@5 on the golden set, and a justification for the shipped one. A number with no measurement scores zero on that line.
Step 1: validates question length 3 to 500 characters. Out-of-range returns 4xx, never 500.
Step 2: cache check, skipped for follow-up questions.
Step 3: embeds with the same model as the indexer.
Step 4: top-k read from ConfigMap; metadata filter excludes superseded: true unless the user explicitly asks about an older version.
Step 5: prompt order is instructions, then numbered evidence, then the question. Retrieved text is delimited.
Step 6: generation uses structured output enforcement (Ollama format= or hosted JSON mode/response schema) at low temperature.
Step 7: Pydantic validation, retry once, then a safe canned fallback. Confirm with a stub that returns invalid output twice that the HTTP status is 200 and the body is a valid Answer.
Step 8: stores the turn, and a cache entry only when safe.
Relevance floor: when nothing retrieved clears the floor, returns answered_from_context: false with a message that the corpus does not cover it, without calling the LLM (or with a guarded call).
